subject: ClarityTech integrator accelerator — onboarding & enablement logistics
messages:
From: Sophie Laurent <sophie@claritytech.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 May 2028 16:12:00 +0200
Subject: Kickoff & enablement — ClarityTech x Redwood

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at ClarityTech is excited about the integration possibilities. We want to move from evaluation to a short enablement sprint so our consultants can start recommending Redwood-based flows to customers (pilot customers in Q3).

Can we lock in the onboarding details this week? High-level asks from our side:
- Sandbox access with a 4 vCPU, 16GB memory instance and sample dataset (pseudo PII scrubbed)
- A 2-hour joint walkthrough for our solutions architects (recorded)
- Playbook + mutual action plan (MAP) we can include in our partner portal

I'll attach our initial MAP and a short list of pilot customers. We're aiming for a June 6 readiness date for the first internal enablement.

Best,
Sophie Laurent
Head of Integrations
ClarityTech Consulting

Attachment: ClarityTech_Onboarding_MAP.xlsx (spreadsheet, 64KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Laurent <sophie@claritytech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 May 2028 16:45:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Kickoff & enablement — ClarityTech x Redwood

Hi Sophie — great to hear, and thanks for sending the MAP. Looping in Ben (partner ops) for sandbox provisioning and Rishi (solutions) for the joint walkthrough and playbook items.

Quick plan:
- Ben will provision a sandbox and send access credentials (we prefer ephemeral tokens; if you need static creds we can discuss). Target: 48 hours.
- Rishi and Laura will co-author a short partner playbook and a one-page MAP for your portal; draft ready by May 31.
- We'll schedule a 2-hour enablement session the week of June 3 (options: June 4 afternoon CET or June 6 morning CET) and record it.

Can you confirm which date you prefer and whether your pilot customers require EU-region hosting? Also confirm whether the dataset in the MAP is scrubbed (you noted pseudo PII).

Thanks — I'll follow up with a calendar invite once we confirm.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Director, Partner Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_partner_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Laurent <sophie@claritytech.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 26 May 2028 10:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Kickoff & enablement — sandbox access + creds

Hi Sophie — provisioning in progress. Delivery plan:
- Sandbox: eu-west-1 small dev node (4 vCPU / 16GB) with API key and ephemeral session tokens.
- Sample dataset: I reviewed the MAP; please confirm final scrubbed CSV by EOD today so we can upload and seed indexes.
- Credentials: sending a separate secure note with a one-time setup password and instructions to rotate tokens.

I'll attach the temporary credentials file and an operations checklist for your SAs. Please treat the creds as sensitive.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sandbox-access-credentials.txt (text, 1KB)
Attachment: partner-onboard-checklist.md (markdown, 6KB)

From: Sophie Laurent <sophie@claritytech.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 08:13:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Kickoff & enablement — ClarityTech x Redwood

Thanks everyone — confirming:
- June 6 morning CET works best for our team (09:30–11:30 CET).
- The MAP dataset has been scrubbed and attached to this thread (we'll send the final CSV to Ben privately if needed).
- EU hosting is required for two pilot customers; appreciate the eu-west-1 sandbox.

Two quick asks before the enablement session:
1) Can you share a one-page integration checklist we can hand to our consultants?
2) Any recommended quantization/latency profiles for hybrid workloads (low-latency chat + nightly batch embeddings)?

Looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Sophie

Attachment: pilot_list_scrubbed.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Laurent <sophie@claritytech.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 16:20:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Kickoff & enablement — ClarityTech x Redwood

Thanks Sophie — confirmed for June 6 09:30–11:30 CET. Action items from our side (we'll drop deliverables into the Drive link before the session):
- One-page integration checklist (target: May 31 EOD) — includes sandbox checklist, required IAM roles, token rotation guidance, and suggested evals.
- Short guidance doc on quantization/latency tradeoffs (we recommend int8 quant profiles for nightly embedding jobs, and a mixed-precision (fp16) low-latency path for chat).
- Recorded walkthrough + sample prompts and prompt-eval kit.

Laura and I will create the recorded 30-minute pre-read that your SAs can watch; the joint session will be hands-on and include a live prompt-tuning demo.

I'll post the HubSpot MAP and the DocuSign agreement link once Ben confirms the sandbox is reachable.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Related links: https://hubspot.redwood/contacts/4982 ; https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/partner/claritytech/onboarding
